pricing.lead: No hidden fees, no surprise add-ons. Everything is included in the monthly subscription except major changes (full redesign, brand new page) which require a separate quote.
pricing.faq1A: The subscription covers hosting, domain and maintenance — costs spread over the year. After the first year, you can cancel any time with 1 month's notice.
pricing.faq2A: Automatic backups, security updates, uptime monitoring and minor content changes (text, photos, hours).
pricing.faq3A: Yes — domain, content and site are yours. If you cancel, I hand over the source code and help you migrate.
pricing.faq4Q: What if I need more than 8 pages?
pricing.faq4A: Additional pages are billed individually ($80 to $150 CAD depending on complexity), then included in the subscription.
pricing.faq5A: 50 % deposit on signature (Stripe), balance at delivery. The monthly subscription starts the month following go-live.

profile.fallbackBio: Eight years building websites for international media (Marie Claire, TechRadar, Kiplinger), major Québec players (Vidéotron, TVA Nouvelles, Groupe Investiir, Groupe Alesco) and SMBs in real estate and healthcare. École 42 Paris graduate, now based in Brossard. I bring that craft — usually reserved for big brands — to local artisans and shopkeepers who want a site that's truly their own.

terms.intro: Applicable to any order placed with Matthieu Rivière, freelance in Québec (Canada), through the website rivierematthieu.com.
terms.p1: These terms govern the design, delivery and maintenance of a showcase website under one of the three plans (STARTER, STANDARD, PREMIUM).
terms.p2: Prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD), GST/QST not applicable (small supplier). The plan covers a one-time build and a recurring monthly subscription (hosting, domain, maintenance and minor changes).
terms.p3: A 50 % deposit is due on order, charged via Stripe at signature. The balance is invoiced on delivery. The monthly subscription is debited on the 1st of each month and the first month is included in the first invoice.
terms.p4: Delivery takes 4 to 10 business days after receipt of the deposit and all required materials (text, photos, logo, domain access if applicable).
terms.p5: The monthly subscription has a minimum 12-month commitment. Beyond that, you can cancel at any time with 1 month's notice, by email to contact{'@'}rivierematthieu.com.
terms.p6: Minor changes (text, photos, hours) are included in the subscription. Major evolutions (full redesign, brand-new page, new feature) require a separate quote.
terms.p7: The client retains ownership of their domain name and the content they provide. The source code is handed over on request at the end of the commitment.
terms.p8: Matthieu Rivière makes every effort to ensure availability but cannot be held responsible for downtime caused by the host, third-party attacks, or client interventions on the site.
terms.p9: These terms are governed by the laws in force in the Province of Québec (Canada). Any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the Québec judicial district, after an attempt at amicable resolution.
